DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日はどのようなご用件ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What brings you here today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 財布を拾いました。そばに小銭も落ちていたので、分けて持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾った財布と近くの小銭を分けて持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a wallet. There were coins nearby too, so I brought them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you brought a found wallet and nearby coins separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこで、いつ見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where and when did you find them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅前のベンチの下で、今日の昼十二時ごろです。財布は茶色です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駅前ベンチ下で今日十二時ごろ見つけた茶色の財布だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Under a bench in front of the station around noon today. The wallet is brown.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe a brown wallet found under the station-front bench around noon today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 小銭は財布の中から落ちたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did the coins fall out of the wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見ていないのでわかりません。財布の近くにあっただけで、同じ人の物とは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小銭が財布から落ちたとは見ておらず、同じ所有者とは断定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not see, so I do not know. They were only near the wallet, and I cannot say they have the same owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you did not see the coins fall from the wallet and cannot confirm the same owner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかりました。財布の中に小銭を戻したり、カードを確認したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Did you put the coins in the wallet or check the cards?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: していません。小銭は別の袋に入れ、財布の中は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小銭は別袋で財布に戻さず、中も見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I put the coins in a separate bag and did not look inside the wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that the coins are in a separate bag, not returned to the wallet, and you did not inspect inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発見状況を分けて記録します。連絡先の記入についてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record the finding circumstances separately. I will explain entering your contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 財布と小銭が別々に見つかったと記録してください。連絡先の欄を確認して書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別々の発見状況で記録してほしいと伝え、連絡先欄を確認して記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please record that the wallet and coins were found separately. I will check and fill out the contact field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to record the separate finding circumstances, then check and complete the contact field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。届けていただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for handing them in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。今日は何をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to send today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ会社に封筒を二通送りたいです。一つは私、もう一つは妻の書類で、別々に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ会社へ本人と妻の書類を別々の封筒で二通送りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two envelopes to the same company. One contains my documents and the other my wife's, and I will send them separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want two separate envelopes containing your and your wife's documents sent to the same company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中を一つにまとめず、それぞれ受付するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: So we should accept each separately rather than combine the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、提出先から別々の封筒で送るよう案内されています。差出人の名前も二人分で違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先の指示で別封筒にし、差出人の名前も異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the receiving office instructed us to use separate envelopes. The two sender names differ too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that separate envelopes are required by the recipient and the sender names differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 封筒の差出人を確認します。控えも別々になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the sender details. The receipts will also be separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらの控えがどの封筒のものか、番号を照合してから受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 控え番号と封筒の対応を照合してから受け取りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to compare the numbers to confirm which receipt belongs to which envelope before receiving them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to match receipt numbers with envelopes before taking the receipts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号を各封筒に付けて受付します。こちらがご本人、こちらが奥様の封筒です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will attach a number to each envelope when accepting them. This one is yours and this one is your wife's.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号と名前が対応しています。この二枚の控えを、家でも別々に保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番号と名前の対応を確認し、二枚の控えを別々に保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The numbers match the names. I will keep these two receipts separately at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the number-name matching and say you will store the two receipts separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方とも宛先は同じ会社です。部門名もこの表記でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both are addressed to the same company. Is the department name written correctly too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、部門名も案内と合っています。二通を別々に、この宛先でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社と部門名が案内と一致すると確認し、二通別々の発送を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, the department also matches the instructions. Please send the two separately to this address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the company and department match the instructions and request two separate shipments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二通分の控えをお渡しします。ご利用ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are your receipts for the two envelopes. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のご案内で何をご相談になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の通知が家に届きます。電子の通知に変更できる種類を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座通知のうち電子通知へ変更できる種類を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Account notices arrive at home. I want to check which types can be changed to electronic notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check which account notices can be changed to electronic delivery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの通知でしょうか。お手元の封筒や書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which notice is it? Do you have the envelope or documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この取引案内です。同居の家族に内容を見られたくないので、受け取り方を相談しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 取引案内を示し、同居家族に内容を見られたくないため受取り方法を相談すると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This transaction notice. I am discussing how to receive it because I do not want family living with me to see the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the transaction notice and explain you want to discuss delivery because you do not want household family seeing its contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この取引案内は電子通知に変更できます。ただ、すべての書類の郵送を止められるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This transaction notice can become electronic, but that does not mean all mailed documents can be stopped.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この案内だけ変更できるんですね。郵送が残る書類も、変更前に一覧で知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: この案内だけ変更可能と理解し、郵送が残る書類の一覧を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So only this notice can change. Before changing, I also want a list of documents that will still be mailed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you understand this notice can change and want a list of documents that will remain postal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象外の書類の一覧を確認できます。勤務先への送付を希望されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the list of excluded documents. Do you want them sent to your workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、勤務先にも送らないでください。電子化できる分を確認し、残る郵便の受取り方は自分で考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先への送付は希望せず、電子化できる分と残る郵便を自分で検討すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: No, please do not send them there either. I will check what can become electronic and think myself about receiving the remaining mail.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you do not want workplace delivery and will consider the electronic options and remaining mail yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。この通知の変更手順と、対象外の一覧をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I will give you this notice's change procedure and the exclusions list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧を読んでから、この取引案内の電子通知を申し込みます。全部の郵送が止まるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象外一覧を読んでこの案内の電子化を申し込み、全郵送停止とは考えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: After reading the list, I will apply to make this transaction notice electronic. I will not assume all postal deliveries stop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will read the exclusions list, apply for this notice's electronic delivery, and not assume all mail stops. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご不明な点を確認してお進めください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed after checking anything unclear. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。商品について何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このソースは常温の棚にありますが、家でもずっと常温でよいのか表示を読んでほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 常温棚のソースを家でずっと常温に置けるか、商品表示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This sauce is on a room-temperature shelf. Could you read the label to see whether I can always keep it at room temperature at home too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the label to see whether a sauce on a room-temperature shelf may always stay at room temperature at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは未開封の保存方法です。開封後の注意は、裏のこの欄にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the unopened storage method. Instructions after opening are in this field on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 開封前と後で欄が違うんですね。裏には開封後は冷蔵と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封と開封後の欄が別と理解し、開封後は冷蔵と書かれているか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the unopened and opened instructions are separate. Does the back say to refrigerate after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you understand unopened and opened instructions differ and check whether it says to refrigerate after opening. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、この商品の表示にはそうあります。似た容器でも商品ごとの表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, that is what this product's label says. Check each product's label even if containers look alike.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい方は冷蔵庫に入りません。小さい容器の商品にも、同じ開封後の表示があるか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大容器は冷蔵庫に入らないため、小容器商品の開封後の表示も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The larger one will not fit in my fridge. I want to check whether the smaller container has the same after-opening instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the large container will not fit your fridge, so you also want to check the smaller product's after-opening label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの小さい商品も、開封後は冷蔵と表示されています。容器の高さは実物で比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: This smaller product also says refrigerate after opening. You can compare the actual container heights.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 小さい方なら入ります。開封したら冷蔵庫に置けるので、こちらを一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小容器なら冷蔵庫に入り、開封後も置けるので一つ購入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The small one fits. I can put it in the fridge after opening, so I will buy one of these.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the smaller container fits your fridge after opening, so you will buy one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開封後の注意を確認できましたね。期限の表示も見えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have checked the after-opening instructions. Can you see the date marking too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、期限も確認しました。常温の棚にあったことだけで判断せず、開封後の表示に従います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期限も確認し、売場の置き方だけで判断せず開封後の表示に従うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I checked the date too. I will follow the after-opening label rather than judge only from its position on a room-temperature shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the date and will follow the after-opening label rather than judge solely by shop storage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園のご利用について何をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 十人で集合写真を撮りたいです。通路をふさがずに並べる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十人の集合写真で通路を塞がず並べる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ten of us want a group photo. Is there somewhere to line up without blocking the path?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where ten people can line up for a group photo without blocking the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は東側の広場が空いています。三脚や大きな照明は使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The eastern square is free today. Will you use a tripod or large lights?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯だけです。撮影する人は一人で、何度も通路を止めるような撮り方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯と撮影者一人だけで、何度も通路を止める撮り方はしないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only a phone. One person will take it, and we will not repeatedly stop people on the path for photos.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only a phone and one photographer and will not keep stopping traffic on the path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 東の広場で短時間なら、この利用の仕方で撮れます。遊具の前は避けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may take photos in this manner briefly in the eastern square. Please avoid the front of the play equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 東の広場にします。遊んでいる子どもが背景に入らない向きを選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 東の広場を選び、遊ぶ子どもが背景に入らない向きを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will use the eastern square. I want a direction that keeps playing children out of the background.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the eastern square and ask for a direction without playing children in the background. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 広場の端の木を背景にすると、遊具の方を向かずに撮れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: With the tree at the square's edge behind you, you can photograph without facing the play equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 木を背景にします。他の方が通ったら撮影を待ち、どいてくださいとは頼まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 木を背景にし、他人が通れば撮影を待ち退去を頼まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will use the tree as the background. If someone passes, we will wait rather than ask them to move away.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the tree as background and wait if people pass instead of asking them to leave. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 周りを確認しながらお願いします。撮り終わったら並んだ荷物も片付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch your surroundings. Clear away the arranged belongings when you finish too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真だけ撮って荷物を片付けます。十人が長く同じ場所を占めないよう、終わったら移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撮影後は荷物を片付け、十人で長く占有せず移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will only take the photo and clear our belongings. We will move afterward so ten people do not occupy the same place for long.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will clear belongings after the photo and move rather than let ten people occupy the place for a long time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。周囲への配慮をありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for being considerate of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車について何をお調べですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you checking about the trains?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 時刻表では十時の列車があるのに来ません。今日の便を確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 十時の列車が来ないため、今日の便を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The timetable shows a ten o'clock train, but it has not come. Could you check today's service?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check today's train because the ten o'clock train has not come. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見ていた時刻表はありますか。今日は土曜日ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the timetable you were looking at? Today is Saturday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この写真です。平日の欄を撮っていました。今日も同じだと思って待っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮った時刻表が平日欄で、今日も同じと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: This photo. I photographed the weekday column. I was waiting because I thought today was the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your timetable photo was the weekday column and you thought today was the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本日の土曜の便は十時二十分です。十時の便が遅れているという案内ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's Saturday service is at 10:20. This is not an announcement of a delayed ten o'clock train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 欄を取り違えていたんですね。十時二十分の列車は、このホームから出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 欄を取り違えたと理解し、十時二十分の便がこのホームか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I confused the columns, then. Does the 10:20 train leave from this platform?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you understand you confused the columns and ask whether the 10:20 train uses this platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、このホームです。行き先もこちらの表示で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, this platform. You can check the destination on this display too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行き先は合っています。待ち合わせの相手には、遅延ではなく自分が時刻表を見間違えたと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行先を確認し、相手へ遅延ではなく自分の見間違いだったと連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The destination is correct. I will tell the person I am meeting that I misread the timetable, rather than that the train was delayed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the destination and say you will tell the other person it was your misreading rather than a delay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次は休日の欄と、当日の案内表示を一緒にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Next time, please check the holiday column together with the day's guidance display.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 休日の欄を撮り直し、今日の十時二十分の便を待ちます。次の予定もその時刻で調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休日欄を撮り直し、十時二十分の便に合わせて予定を調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will photograph the holiday column again and wait for today's 10:20 train. I will adjust my next plans to that time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will retake the holiday-column photo and adjust plans to the 10:20 train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お気を付けてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care when boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。記入でお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Do you need help filling anything in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所が欄に入りません。部屋番号を省いてよいのか、書く前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所欄に収まらず部屋番号を省いてよいか記入前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My address will not fit in the field. Before writing, I want to check whether I may omit the room number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before filling in whether you may omit the room number because the address does not fit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 省かずに記入しましょう。どこまで書けましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please include it. How much have you written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番地までは書きました。建物名と二〇三号室が、まだ書けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番地までは書けたが建物名と二〇三号室が未記入だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote through the street number. The building name and room 203 are still missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the street number is written but the building name and room 203 are unfilled. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この書類は住所の続き欄が裏面にあります。表の欄から続くことを示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This form has an address-continuation field on the back. You can indicate that it continues from the front.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏面の続き欄に、建物名と二〇三号室を書きます。小さい字で無理に押し込まなくてよいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 裏面の続き欄に残りを書き、小文字で無理に詰める必要はないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write the building name and room 203 in the continuation field. I do not need to squeeze it in with tiny writing, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the rest in the back continuation field and confirm there is no need to squeeze in tiny writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、この書類では続き欄を使ってください。別の書類もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, use that field on this form. Do you have another form too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一枚あります。でも同じ方法でよいとは決めず、その用紙の住所欄も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: もう一枚の用紙は同じ方法と決めず、その住所欄も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: One more. But I will not assume the same method applies; I want to check that form's address field too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check the other form's address field without assuming the same method applies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: もう一枚には続き欄がありません。そちらの記入方法は担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The other form has no continuation field. I will ask the person in charge how to fill it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚目は裏面を使い、二枚目はまだ空欄にします。二つの用紙を別々に確認してから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚目は裏面を使い二枚目は未記入で、各用紙を確認してから提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use the back for the first and leave the second blank for now. I will check each form separately before submitting them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will use the first form's back, leave the second unfilled, and check each before submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。用紙ごとの方法を確認しましょう。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the method for each form. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご予約について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: グエンです。予約日時を確認したいのですが、電話で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約者名を伝え、電話で予約日時を確認できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is Nguyen. I want to confirm my appointment date and time. Can I do so over the phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your booking name and ask whether you can confirm the appointment date and time by phone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じお名前の予約が二件あります。お手元に診察券や予約票はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two bookings under that name. Do you have a patient card or appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約票があります。番号の末尾は四二です。別の方の予定を変更しないよう、本人の番号で見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約票の番号末尾四二を伝え、別人の予約を変更しないよう本人番号での確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the slip. The number ends in 42. Please check my own number so we do not change someone else's appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the appointment number's final digits 42 and ask to check by your number to avoid changing someone else's booking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 本人確認のため生年月日を伺います。予約票のお名前もフルネームでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: For identity verification, please give your date of birth and the full name on the appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この票のフルネームと生年月日をお伝えします。短い名前だけでは同じ人と判断しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: フルネームと生年月日を伝え、短い名前だけで同一人物と判断しないよう確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give the full name and date of birth from this slip. Please do not assume a short name alone identifies the same person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the full name and date of birth and confirm that a short name alone should not determine identity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一致した予約は来週木曜の十一時です。変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The matching appointment is next Thursday at eleven. Would you like to change it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 変更はしません。手帳では水曜と書いてしまったので、正しい木曜を確認したかっただけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約変更ではなく、手帳の水曜という記録が誤りか確認したかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I mistakenly wrote Wednesday in my planner, so I only wanted to confirm the correct Thursday date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not want an appointment change, only to check whether the Wednesday entry in your planner was wrong. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約は木曜十一時のままです。もう一件の予約には変更を加えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your appointment remains Thursday at eleven. The other booking has not been changed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手帳を木曜十一時に直しました。私の予約は変更せず、番号四二の予約票を持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 木曜十一時へ手帳を直し、予約は変更せず該当番号の票を持参すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I corrected my planner to Thursday at eleven. I will keep my booking unchanged and bring the appointment slip ending in 42.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you corrected the planner to Thursday at eleven, will leave the booking unchanged and bring the slip with the relevant number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。当日お待ちしています。お電話ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you then. Thank you for calling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。交通の相談で何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about the traffic incident?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の駐車場の接触を説明した図で、私の車の矢印を逆に描きました。訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前日の接触の略図で自車の矢印を逆に描いたため訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: In my diagram of yesterday's parking-lot contact, I drew my car's arrow backward. I want to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to correct your car's reversed arrow in the diagram of yesterday's contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの矢印ですか。車の向きと、実際に進んだ方向を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which arrow? Please explain the car's orientation and its actual direction of movement.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 車の前は出口を向いていましたが、後ろへ動かしました。図では前へ進んだように描いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 車前部は出口向きだが実際は後退し、図では前進を描いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The front faced the exit, but I moved backward. I mistakenly drew it as moving forward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the car faced the exit but reversed, while the diagram shows forward movement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車の向きではなく、動いた方向の矢印を直すのですね。相手の車の矢印も修正しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you are correcting the movement arrow, not the car's orientation. Will you change the other car's arrow too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手が動いたところは見ていません。相手の矢印は、私が推測で書いてしまったので、未確認としたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手の動きは見ておらず推測した矢印なので、未確認としてほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not see it move. I drew its arrow by guessing, so I want to mark that as unconfirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you did not see the other car move and its arrow was guessed, so you want it marked unconfirmed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身が確認した動きと推測を分けます。接触に気づいた位置は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will separate the movements you confirmed from guesses. Do you remember where you noticed the contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この二つ目の区画の横です。音がした時に止まりましたが、相手の速度はわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 接触に気づいた区画を示し、音で停止したが相手速度は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside this second parking space. I stopped when I heard a sound, but I do not know the other car's speed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the parking space where you noticed contact, say you stopped at the sound, and the other car's speed is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本人の図の訂正として記録します。図だけでどちらの責任かを決めるものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record this as your correction to the diagram. The diagram alone does not determine responsibility.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の後退を矢印で直し、相手の動きと速度は未確認と伝えます。責任を決めるための断定はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自車後退を訂正し相手動作速度は未確認で、責任の断定はしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will correct my arrow to show reversing and say the other's movement and speed are unconfirmed. I will not make conclusions about responsibility.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will correct your car to reversing, mark the other's movement and speed unconfirmed, and not conclude responsibility. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。訂正した説明を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the corrected explanation. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。発送後の確認で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble checking something after sending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 控えを写真に撮りましたが、番号の右端が切れています。配達の確認ができません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 控え写真の番号末尾が切れて配達確認できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I photographed the receipt, but the right end of the number is cut off. I cannot check delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the receipt photo cuts off the final digits, preventing a delivery check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの原本はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the original receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家に残しています。今ある写真では最後の数字が読めず、間違った番号を入れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本は自宅で、写真の末尾が不明なまま誤番号を入力した可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I left it at home. The photo's last digits are unreadable, so I may have entered a wrong number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the original is home and you may have entered an incorrect number without knowing the photo's missing final digits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後の数字を推測せず、原本の番号で確認してください。発送日はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not guess the final digits; check using the original number. Do you know the sending date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日です。写真では宛先と日付は読めますが、それだけで配達済みかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送は昨日で写真の日付と宛先は読めるが、配達結果は不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yesterday. I can read the date and destination in the photo, but those alone do not tell me whether it was delivered.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it was sent yesterday and the photo's date and destination are readable, but the delivery result is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうですね。この写真だけで番号を復元したとはお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. We cannot say we have reconstructed the number from this photo alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で原本を見て、番号を最後まで控え直します。別の番号を試し続けるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本で全番号を控え直し、推測した別番号の入力をやめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at the original at home and copy the whole number again. I will stop trying other numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will copy the full number from the original and stop entering guessed alternatives. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原本の番号でも確認できなければ、その控えをご用意のうえ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you cannot check even with the original number, you can consult us with that receipt ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 正確な番号で一度確認し、できなければ原本を持って相談します。今日は配達結果を決めつけません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい番号で確認し、不明なら原本で相談し、今日は結果を断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check once using the exact number and bring the original for advice if it does not work. I will not assume the delivery result today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check with the correct number, consult with the original if unclear, and not conclude the result today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。控えをなくさず保管してください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Keep the receipt safe. Thank you for consulting us.
